slots.purpose: Hero and social share image: a calm, considered honeymoon being shaped with care, signalling value and planning rather than price.
slots.shot_brief: Landscape 3:2 with negative space on one side for a title. Overhead or 45 degree still life on natural linen: two passports (plain covers or face down), a closed leather notebook with a written itinerary page just visible but unreadable, a fountain pen, a pair of sunglasses and a sprig of olive or frangipani. Soft morning window light, warm neutral palette, no people. No airline, hotel, resort, cruise, card or travel brand logos or branding visible anywhere. No money, price tags, currency notes, cards, invoices with figures, calculators showing numbers or any visible figures. No readable names, passport numbers, booking references, barcodes or personal details. Source: library register, Canva brand asset or licensed stock. AI only if Wedded Wonderland approves, and then labelled 'Illustrative image'. Never competitor or search-result images.
